facts.fact: NGARi says Botswana's National AI Policy is in an "advanced stage" and was UNESCO RAM-validated in May 2025.

NGARi says it is building a Setswana AI commons at Botswana University of Agriculture and Natural Resources, with a US$27,000 offline GPU kit scoped and not yet installed, MOUs drafted not signed, and completion targeted for 2027.
